rationales.item_code: Variant-level style codes (TSH-1001, TSH-1002), unique per row: identifies the sellable item. R4.2: variant_of holds the design level instead.
rationales.item_name: Free-text product name (Crew Neck Tee) repeated across variants. R3.3: a label is not an identifier; productFamily holds codes like TSH-1000 and is already claimed by variant_of (R1.2).
rationales.item_group: Constant category label (Knitwear) classifying the product. Judgement call, R4.2: confirm against the productCategory description in the schema. If that field is a controlled delegated-act category list, switch to NO_MAPPING under R4.3.
rationales.variant_of: Holds TSH-1000 / PLO-2000, the design-level code that variants point to. R3.4, R4.2.
rationales.brand: Brand name (Aurora) is a trade name, not the manufacturer operator. R4.3: no CDM field for brand; manufacturerName is the legal entity, so mapping would be a guess.
rationales.stock_uom: Holds Nos, a stock-counting unit. R3.2 / R2.2.
rationales.country_of_origin: ISO alpha-2 code (LK). Direct match, R3.4.
rationales.customs_tariff_number: 6-digit HS codes (610910, 610590). R3.4: decided on contents.
rationales.has_batch_no: 1/0 flag meaning batch-tracked, not a batch number. R3.1.
rationales.has_serial_no: 1/0 flag meaning serial-tracked, not a serial number. R3.1.
rationales.weight_per_unit: Decimal weights (0.180); unit sits in weight_uom, so this is the quantity column. R3.2.
rationales.weight_uom: Holds Kg, the unit for weight_per_unit. R3.2.
rationales.description: Marketing copy (Single jersey crew neck). R3.3.
rationales.shelf_life_in_days: Integer days, all 0; ERP storage shelf life, not product durability. R2.2. If durability is defined in days in the schema, revisit under R4.2.
rationales.care_instructions: Machine wash 30C is a care instruction. R3.4.
rationales.co2e_kg: Decimals in kg CO2e per unit (4.20). R4.1: carbonFootprint is more specific than environmentalFootprint.
rationales.recycled_pct: Integer percentages (20, 0) of recycled content. R3.4.
rationales.buyer_po: PO-88412 style purchase order numbers. R3.4.
rationales.supplier_gln: 13-digit party identifier (GLN) for the supplier. R4.3: genuinely ambiguous between manufacturerOperatorId, otherOperatorIdentifiers and facilityIdentifiers, and a supplier need not be the manufacturer. Revisit if the schema descriptions settle it.
